bullets.text: Nvidia's AI Acquisitions Surge — Nvidia is reportedly acquiring Hugging Face for $13 billion, reflecting a trend where companies invest heavily in open-weight AI models to diversify their offerings.
Meta Enhances Privacy Features — Meta is updating its Ray-Ban smart glasses to prevent users from disabling the privacy LED, addressing ongoing concerns about unauthorized recording.
Smartphone Prices Set to Rise — Analysts predict that smartphone prices will remain high permanently, impacting consumers as low-end devices become scarce and expensive.
Apple's Smart Glasses Launch — Apple plans to release AI-powered smart glasses next year, featuring voice interaction and camera capabilities, marking its entry into the smart eyewear market.
Meta's Ongoing Privacy Challenges — Meta continues to address privacy issues with its smart glasses, as it faces scrutiny over how it manages user data and recording features.
